normalized_primary_mechanics: Take event 定朔/弦望/恒氣 small remainder.
Multiply the small remainder by 12 for the 12-shichen clock conversion.
Full 10000 units determine the shichen position counted from 子正.
The half-shichen threshold is 5000 in the multiplied coordinate and uses the 初 label family.
Residual source fractions are converted to ke under the 100-ke day.

reasoning: The primary 1569 conversion counts the internal day clock from 子正.
The event small remainder is bounded below the next 10000-unit day.
Late 子初 is therefore represented before the next 子正 rollover in this calendar-astronomy coordinate.
Published comparisons preserve examples labelled 夜子初 immediately before the next 子正 boundary.

scope_firewalls.rationale: This is the day/time coordinate used by Ming calendrical astronomy for qishuo/event timing. It is not an astrological doctrine for Bazi or Ziwei date rollover.

evidence.finding: Ming institutional records explicitly distinguish Beijing and Nanjing polar altitude, sunrise/sunset and clepsydra/timekeeping behavior.
Late-Ming witness preserves the policy dispute over Beijing versus Nanjing daylength values in Datong almanacs.
International peer-reviewed reconstruction verifies Shoushi-Licheng sunrise/sunset tables as Beijing and Mingshi Datong sunrise/sunset tables as Nanjing.
International peer-reviewed reconstruction independently reproduces the Datongli sunrise/sunset subsystem and its location-dependent tables.

geographic_realization.unresolved_question: Which geographical/meridian reference was operationally attached to qishuo/conjunction small remainder in the 1578 official Datong almanac context?

overseas_oracle_expansion.note: This broadens the official-almanac evidence pool beyond current East Asian holdings and is not yet transcribed into a qishuo fixture.
